title: Coordinate characterization of a Godement tensor map
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme and $H,K$ be $\mathcal O_X$-module sheaves, with the sectionwise and sheaf tensor products of [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Write $T$ for the product of stalk skyscrapers [def-sc-module-cup-godement-model]. Define $\tau_{H,K}:H^{pre}\otimes K^{pre}\to(H\otimes K)^{pre}$ as the sheafification adjunction unit followed by the inverse tensor-to-sheafification comparison. For a family $b(H,K):T(H)\otimes T(K)\to T(H\otimes K)$, ModuleCupGodementTensorCoordinates means that there are operations $t_{H,K,x}:H_x\times K_x\to(H\otimes K)_x$ satisfying two formulas. On germs of sections over any common neighbourhood $U$, $t(germ(s),germ(r))=germ(\tau_{H,K}(s\otimes r))$. On sections $s$ of $T(H)$ and $r$ of $T(K)$ over $U$ containing $x$, the $x$ coordinate of $b(H,K)(\tau_{T(H),T(K)}(s\otimes r))$ equals $t_{H,K,x}(\pi_{H,x}(s),\pi_{K,x}(r))$, where each projection value is evaluated at $x$. These formulas impose no naturality, unit, or multiplication law.
